biotools.summary: ABDS is an R tool suite designed for analyzing biologically diverse samples, specifically addressing challenges with missing data imputation, signature gene detection, and differential pattern visualization. It provides tools for mechanistic imputation, group-wise testing, and heatmap visualization.
